arStrings.szText:
Your Evade transforms you into an angry Lunatic for up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds that explodes dealing {c_important}Command Fallen's{/c} damage and increasing by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2" * 100|%x|]{/c} for every second you're transformed for.

While you are an angry Lunatic, your Movement speed is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|x%|]{/c} and you periodically spawn a Mini Lunatic that seeks enemies. 

{c_important}Command Fallen{/c} deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
